Name: Buy 14 heart event furniture and clothing
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Lets you buy furniture and clothing in shops that's normally locked behind marriage
Description:
_Description_

*   Simple mod that let's you buy furniture in shops that's normally locked behind marriage
_How to get the furniture in-game_
Go to Robin's shop for Penny's home made furniture. Furniture and Wallpaper from each of the different themes will be sold on different days.

The Dwarf stole sam's boombox and Leah's sculpture. Visit his shop to buy them back.

You drew a portrait of Marnie and she's made copies she's now selling in her shop.

Emily's Magic Clothing is a popular new fashion trend among shadow people, and Krobus keeps stock.

_Mods that work well with this one_

*   [Museum Store](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12598)

*   [Penny themed furniture recolors](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10327)﻿﻿

*   [Krobus furniture and wallpaper](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11043)

*   [Vanilla Spouseroom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12187)﻿﻿
